item.title: A9 Dualling Delivery Plan Confirms Capital Funding and Accelerated Northern Works
item.description: The Scottish Government has confirmed capital funding for the remaining A9 dualling works, with a new delivery plan accelerating key junction upgrades in the Highlands and setting out a clear route to full dualling by 2035.The post A9 Dualling Delivery Plan Confirms Capital Funding and Accelerated Northern Works appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Appeal After Housebreakings in Lochaber
item.description: Two housebreakings in Lochaber have prompted a police appeal after cash and jewellery were stolen from properties near Spean Bridge and in Banavie, Fort William, with officers asking locals to check CCTV and report suspicious activity.The post Appeal After Housebreakings in Lochaber appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: NSPCC Warns Gaps in Sex Education Leave Scottish Children Exposed to Online Abuse
item.description: New research reveals one in four adults in Scotland believe current sex education fails to protect children from online abuse, prompting renewed calls from the NSPCC for mandatory, consistent RSHP education to better safeguard young people.The post NSPCC Warns Gaps in Sex Education Leave Scottish Children Exposed to Online Abuse appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Surviving Politics in 2026 Brings Kate Forbes and Fraser Nelson to Glasgow
item.description: As politics accelerates in 2026, the John Smith Centre brings Kate Forbes and Fraser Nelson to Glasgow for a live debate on power, pressure, and public life, continuing a series that champions open discussion and civic engagement.The post Surviving Politics in 2026 Brings Kate Forbes and Fraser Nelson to Glasgow appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Council Praises Staff and Communities After Severe Winter Weather
item.description: Severe winter weather tested communities across the Highlands in early January, with road closures, school disruption, and freezing temperatures, as Highland Council praised staff, volunteers, and residents for their resilience, dedication, and collective response during one of the toughest periods of the winter.The post Highland Council Praises Staff and Communities After Severe Winter Weather appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Appeal Launched After Series of Housebreakings Across The Highlands
item.description: Police are appealing for information after a series of housebreakings across the Highlands, with incidents reported in Fort Augustus, Drumnadrochit, Lochaber, and Kingussie, as officers urge residents to remain vigilant and review CCTV or dash cam footage.The post Appeal Launched After Series of Housebreakings Across The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Direct Flights to Dublin Return From Inverness
item.description: Direct flights between Inverness and Dublin will return from May 2026, reconnecting the Highlands with Ireland’s capital and opening up onward travel to North America through Aer Lingus services, strengthening international connectivity for business and leisure travellers.The post Direct Flights to Dublin Return From Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orkney Praised for Collective Effort During Prolonged Winter Weather
item.description: Orkney Islands Council has praised staff, volunteers, farmers, and emergency services after prolonged winter weather tested the islands, highlighting community resilience, long hours on the frontline, and a collective response that kept people safe during some of the toughest conditions of the winter.The post Orkney Praised for Collective Effort During Prolonged Winter Weather appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Poll Shows SNP Lead as Westminster Parties Fight for Second Place
item.description: The first poll of 2026 puts the SNP clearly in the lead ahead of the Holyrood election, with Westminster parties trailing behind as support centres on leadership, delivery, and renewed debate over Scotland’s future and the case for independence.The post Poll Shows SNP Lead as Westminster Parties Fight for Second Place appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Mattel and Hot Wheels Introduce First Ever Honda Collector Builds
item.description: Mattel and Hot Wheels have unveiled their first ever Honda Brick Shop builds, bringing the iconic Civic EF and S2000 to life as detailed collector sets that celebrate Japanese performance culture and hands on automotive design.The post Mattel and Hot Wheels Introduce First Ever Honda Collector Builds appeared first on The Highland Times.
